sloka: तं समीक्ष्य महासत्त्वं सत्त्ववान् हरिसत्तमः ।वाक्यमर्थवदव्यग्रस्तमुवाच दशाननम् ।। ५.५१.१।।।।
transliteration: taṁ samīkṣya mahāsattvaṁ sattvavān harisattamaḥ ।vākyamarthavadavyagrastamuvāca daśānanam ।। 5.51.1।।।।

translations.english: Hanuman, the best of monkeys, looking at the very powerful Ravana spoke slowly these highly meaningful words.
